title: What's new in Expense Agent: Project Handling
summary: This session covers what is new in Expense Agent for projects. Users can now pick projects on expenses in the web app, not only in Business Central. Admins turn on project tracking in the setup guide and choose between all projects or only assigned projects. Assignment is done with a new Assigned resources section on the project card, and optionally per project task. The demo shows an expense in the web app with a project and task, the result in the Business Central expense report with a preview posting, and how adding a resource to a second project makes it appear in the web app.

Demo: expense report and preview posting in Business Central

features.name: Project tracking in the Expense Agent web app
features.description: Projects can now be used on expenses in the web app, based on user feedback. The admin enables project tracking in the Expense Agent setup guide, otherwise the project option does not show in the web app.
caveats: If project tracking is not enabled, the project option is not shown in the web app at all
prerequisites: Enable project tracking in the Expense Agent setup guide

features.name: Project visibility: all projects or assigned projects
features.description: A setup option decides whether all users see all projects in the web app or only the projects they are assigned to. Assigned projects helps when there are hundreds of projects or when some projects must stay hidden.
caveats: The demo uses the all projects option, not assigned projects, at setup time

features.name: Assigned resources on the project card
features.description: The project card has a new Assigned resources section where resources are selected per project. All assigned resources see that project, with all its tasks, in the web app. If no resources are listed, the setup is inherited from the project card.
caveats: Adding yourself to a project makes it appear in the web app list
prerequisites: A resource exists for each employee
The resource number is set on the employee card

features.name: Assigning resources to specific project tasks
features.description: Users can be assigned to individual tasks instead of the whole project by going to the project task lines and choosing resources for the task. Those users can then pick only the tasks they are assigned to.
caveats: In the demo no task-level assignment was set, which is why all tasks were visible

features.name: Resource link on the employee card
features.description: Each employee needs a resource, and the resource number is selected on the employee card. The system then recognizes the user when working with expense management.
prerequisites: Create a resource for each employee
Select the resource number on the employee card

features.name: Selecting project and task on a web app expense
features.description: In the web app a user edits an expense and selects a project and a task, then saves. Only active projects and only tasks enabled for posting are offered, not beginning and end totals.
caveats: Only project tasks enabled for posting are shown
prerequisites: User assigned to the project when assigned visibility is used

features.name: Project ledger entries from expense reports
features.description: The project and task chosen on the expense show in the billable information of the Business Central expense report. A preview posting shows the project ledger entry created automatically. Project ledger entries on posting were already available in the first release.
caveats: The expense report was not posted in the demo, only a preview posting was shown
prerequisites: Project and project task set on the expense
